context_for_next_testing_agent: Accounting module (Contabilidad Escolar) fully functional. Route is /school/:subdomain/contabilidad. Admin roles (owner/admin/director) can access. Features: Dashboard with 4 summary cards (Ingresos Confirmados, Egresos Totales, Pagos Pendientes, Balance del Mes), Payments tab with CRUD and status management (pending/paid/canceled), Expenses tab with CRUD. IGV 18% calculation automatic. Currency is Soles (S/.). Payment concepts: matricula, mensualidad, taller, uniforme, material, evento, otros. Expense categories: servicios, personal, mantenimiento, materiales, otros. Payment methods: efectivo, transferencia, yape, plin, tarjeta.
